newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Schmidheiny's Anova cuts stake in Valora.
newsitem.headline: Schmidheiny's Anova cuts stake in Valora.

text.p: Stephan Schmidheiny's Anova Holding AG has reduced its stake in Valora Holding AG to less than five percent by selling stock on the bourse, Valora said.
"Anova cited its changed strategic orientation as the reason for selling the shares," it said, without giving more details.
It said Anova's managing director, Jacques Kaegi, had submitted his resignation from Valora's board. His successor will be elected at the shareholders' meeting on June 25.
Shares of Valora, a retailer and restaurant operator, closed yesterday at 318 Swiss francs. Anova had had a stake of around 9.6 percent, according to SBC Warburg's stock guide.
